name: Carbon Race Corp.
summary: Based in Broadview, Illinois, Carbon Race Corp. is a technology enterprise focused on developing and distributing specialized software-defined radio (SDR) applications. These applications serve both commercial and military mobile wireless communication networks. The company's principal offering is PC4 technology, which is specifically designed for military and homeland defense sectors to power large-scale, adaptable wireless communication infrastructures for defense purposes. PC4, an acronym for Programmable, Command, Control, Compute, and Communicate, functions as an innovative SDR framework alongside a proprietary operating system. Its design prioritizes interoperability, compactness, and mobility for military communication systems. Furthermore, the PC4 framework is also applicable to radar, high-speed digital radio frequency (RF), and GSM surveillance systems.
